correctness.rationale: Linearity of B verified independently (66 distinct pairs). P6-freeness verified by two independent in-lane detectors and auditor re-runs: DFS exhaustive search finds 0 loose 6-paths and independent C(22,6)/permutation check over all 6-sets spanning 13 vertices (2157 sets) finds none. Density arithmetic 22/13>5/3 correct; disjoint copies of B give infinite P6-free family so asymptotic lower bound >=22/13 holds. Two-block rigidity re-executed: 24v/40e union P6-free, 144 linearly-addable cross triples enumerated, all 144 create a P6. Small values n=9,10,12 follow from Schoenheim packing bound plus linear witnesses (verified); n=11 follows from witness (17 linear) plus elementary degree-count ruling out 18 (ten 5s + one 4 would leave 2 uncovered pairs at one vertex versus 1 globally). ILP solver unavailable in-lane but not needed for upper bounds since n<13 makes P6 impossible.
